text:
I could not confirm a 2006 award won by *Avatar: The Last Airbender*. The clearest 2006 link I found is an Annie Award nomination at the 33rd Annie Awards (held February 2006) for Best Animated Television Production, per [Filmaffinity](https://www.filmaffinity.com/en/award-edition-movie.php?edition-id=annie_2006&movie-id=927413). The series' main wins I could verify were at the 34th Annie Awards (2007) for character animation and directing, per [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avatar:_The_Last_Airbender_season_2) and [a library record](https://discovercatalog.lislelibrary.org/Record/1799519), so if a 2006 win exists it's likely a single-episode or individual award I haven't found.

CONFIDENCE: 30
